briefing: - 今日KEV批量公告集中在边界VPN与安全设备，均在野利用。
- 未发现勒索软件关联，但多款边界设备漏洞已遭在野攻击。
- 最紧急：F5与Arista边界设备9月25日到期，CVSS达10。
- 立即修补Check Point、Citrix等KEV边界漏洞。

items.title: RouterOS SSH重协商认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证客户端在SSH重协商后跳过用户认证打开会话通道并发送exec请求，可泄露配置或篡改设备。
items.action_zh: 升级到 6.49.21 或 7.23.4 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 连接SSH端口，客户端主动重协商后未认证打开session通道发exec
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器/防火墙，常暴露公网
items.description: RouterOS SSH enters the connection protocol after a client-requested rekey even though user authentication was never attempted, allowing an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request.

items.title: NetScaler未认证任意命令执行
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者利用输入校验缺陷在ADC/Gateway上执行任意命令，可完全控制设备。
items.repro_note: 面向 ADC/Gateway 网络接口构造特制请求触发命令执行
items.impact_scope: 边界VPN/负载均衡，暴露公网
items.description: Improper input validation vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. This issue affects ADC: before 14.1-73.37, before 13.1-64.23, before 14.1-73.37 FIPS, and before 13.1.37.279 FIPS and NDcPP; Gateway: before 14.1-73.37 and before 13.1-64.23 leading to an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

items.title: BIG-IP APM 堆溢出未认证RCE
items.title_zh: BIG-IP APM 堆溢出未认证RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向同时启用APM访问策略与OAuth配置的虚拟服务器发送恶意流量即可远程执行代码。
items.action_zh: 升级到 17.1.4 或 17.5.2 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 前置需虚拟服务器配置 APM 访问策略与 OAuth 配置文件
items.impact_scope: 边界负载均衡/VPN，承载对外业务
items.description: When a BIG-IP APM access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server, specific malicious traffic can lead to remote code execution (RCE). Impact: This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

items.title: Check Point VPN网关 证书校验缺陷RCE
items.title_zh: Check Point VPN网关 证书校验缺陷RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者利用VPN协商中证书信任校验缺陷，在Quantum安全网关上执行任意代码。
items.repro_note: 向网关发起 VPN 协商，使用伪造 CA 证书绕过信任校验
items.impact_scope: 边界VPN网关，暴露公网
items.description: Improper certificate trust validation during VPN negotiation in Check Point Quantum Security Gateway may allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

items.title: Adobe Commerce 授权错误提权
items.title_zh: Adobe Commerce 授权错误提权
items.summary_zh: 无需用户交互，攻击者利用错误授权访问敏感资源并提升权限，可能导致账户接管。
items.action_zh: 升级到 2.4.4 或 B2B 1.3.3 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 构造越权请求访问受保护资源接口，无需交互即可提升权限
items.impact_scope: 电商平台，涉订单与客户数据
items.description: Adobe Commerce is affected by an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction.

items.title: NetScaler ADC/Gateway 内存破坏RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可利用内存破坏缺陷在ADC/Gateway上实现远程代码执行或造成拒绝服务。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.repro_note: 向 ADC/Gateway 请求处理路径发送畸形数据触发内存破坏
items.impact_scope: 边界负载均衡/VPN 设备
items.description: Vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. This issue affects ADC: before 14.1-73.37, before 13.1-64.23, before 14.1-73.37 FIPS, and before 13.1.37.279 FIPS and NDcPP; Gateway: before 14.1-73.37 and before 13.1-64.23 leading to Remote Code Execution or Denial of Service

items.title: WordPress 未认证模板文件包含
items.title_zh: WordPress 未认证模板文件包含
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可操纵页面模板解析包含主题外本地PHP文件，满足条件时致远程代码执行。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级到 4.7.37 或 4.8.32 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 未授权请求触发 get_page_template() 解析，需服务端与主题满足前置条件
items.impact_scope: 公网CMS站点数量庞大，核心组件
items.description: An unauthenticated attacker can make `get_page_template()` page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories. If relevant pre-conditions for both the server and the active theme are met, this can lead to RCE.

items.title: WSO2 API控制平面 JWT校验绕过
items.title_zh: WSO2 API控制平面 JWT校验绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造使用不支持算法的JWT绕过签名校验，未授权访问系统并可能接管管理员账户。
items.repro_note: 向控制平面接口提交算法伪造的 JWT，绕过签名校验获取令牌
items.impact_scope: API 网关控制面，常暴露或内网
items.description: This allows an attacker to craft a JWT with an unsupported algorithm, which is then incorrectly validated, leading to unauthorized access. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability may result in unauthorized access to the system, including the potential compromise of administrative accounts and full account takeover.

items.title: VeloCloud Orchestrator 未授权访问
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可绕过输入校验访问编排器特权内部功能，危及主机及托管数据机密性与完整性。
items.repro_note: 远程访问 VCO 管理接口，构造绕过校验的请求触达内部功能
items.impact_scope: SD-WAN 编排器，管控全网分支
items.description: VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem has a security issue where this issue may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator. Hosted, including Dedicated, versions of VCO were impacted and have already been patched.

items.title: Check Point 管理服务器未认证上传RCE
items.title_zh: Check Point 管理服务器未认证上传RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者结合目录遍历与文件上传写入并执行任意脚本，可完全控制管理服务器。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级到 R81.10 及以上受支持版本
items.repro_note: 未授权访问管理服务器接口，借路径遍历上传脚本至可执行目录
items.impact_scope: 安全管理服务器，内网核心资产
items.description: A directory traversal and file upload vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts on Check Point Management Server.

items.title: SharePoint Server 代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 已认证攻击者通过网络向SharePoint提交特制请求注入代码，实现远程代码执行。
items.repro_note: 需有效账户登录，向服务端接口提交注入代码的请求
items.impact_scope: 企业内网协同平台，常暴露内部
items.description: Improper control of generation of code ('code injection') in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

items.title: IIS 大小写绕过读取敏感文件
items.title_zh: IIS 大小写绕过读取敏感文件
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者变换路径大小写绕过拒绝规则，经静态文件处理读取配置等敏感文件。
items.action_zh: 临时禁用静态文件处理或收紧规则，及时升级补丁
items.repro_note: 未授权 GET /user/CONFIG/system.YAML 等大小写变体路径探测
items.impact_scope: Windows IIS 站点，托管 Web 服务
items.description: Grav before 2.0.25 ships web server configuration samples whose access-control deny rules are matched case-sensitively. On IIS running over case-insensitive NTFS, an unauthenticated remote attacker can vary the case of a folder name or file extension (for example GET /user/CONFIG/system.YAML) so that no deny rule matches and the IIS static file handler resolves and returns the underlying file, disclosing sensitive data such as configuration secrets or account password hashes.

items.title: 域名配置CRLF注入写入Web配置
items.title_zh: 域名配置CRLF注入写入Web配置
items.summary_zh: 具备域名配置权限的攻击者提交含CRLF的域名，向nginx/Apache虚拟主机注入任意指令。
items.action_zh: 过滤域名控制字符并限制配置写入权限，等待官方修复
items.repro_note: 需可添加域名的权限，提交含 CRLF 的域名验证配置注入
items.impact_scope: 虚拟主机管理面板，影响Web配置
items.description: An authenticated low-privilege customer with subdomain-create rights (no admin or change_serversettings privilege required) can supply a subdomain redirect URL that carries a CR/LF payload in the userinfo portion (e.g. The value passes validation, survives IDNA encoding, and is written verbatim into the generated nginx or Apache vhost configuration, allowing the attacker to break out of the emitted directive and inject arbitrary web-server configuration lines.

items.title: hMailServer 登录参数注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者通过SMTP/POP3/IMAP登录提交特殊密码注入JScript，以服务账户权限执行代码。
items.action_zh: 升级到 6.3.3 之后修复版本，或限制邮件端口来源
items.repro_note: 连接 SMTP AUTH/POP3/IMAP，密码字段填入反斜杠加单引号
items.impact_scope: 邮件服务器，25/110/143常暴露
items.description: Eval injection in the JScript event-script dispatcher in Progressive Robot Ltd's hMailServer, versions 6.0.0 through 6.3.3 on Windows, allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to run arbitrary JScript inside the hMailServer service process, with the privileges of the service account, via a password containing a backslash followed by an apostrophe, sent in any logon (SMTP AUTH, POP3, IMAP) that names an existing, active account.

items.title: OAuth授权码可被静默窃取
items.summary_zh: 攻击者注册指向自控域名的客户端并诱导已登录用户访问授权URL，窃取授权码换取令牌。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 校验redirect_uri白名单并强制授权确认页面，等待修复
items.repro_note: 注册自有域名客户端，诱导已登录受害者访问构造的授权URL
items.impact_scope: OAuth授权服务，账户接管风险
items.description: Because the authorization flow auto-completes for an already logged-in user with no consent screen, an attacker who registers a client pointing at their own domain and induces a logged-in victim to visit a single crafted authorization URL receives an authorization code at the attacker-controlled redirect URI and can exchange it for an access token and refresh token.

items.title: MatchTrustedPeer 证书信任校验绕过
items.title_zh: MatchTrustedPeer 证书信任校验绕过
items.summary_zh: 知晓客户端受信CA的攻击者可伪造CA克隆证书通过校验，实现恶意(D)TLS服务端中间人。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，或临时收紧受信对端证书校验策略
items.repro_note: 搭建恶意(D)TLS服务端，使用已知受信CA签发的伪造证书
items.impact_scope: TLS客户端/嵌入式通信组件
items.description: MatchTrustedPeer ignores the public key used, leading to forged CA clones passing verification. When the certificate is listed as a trusted peer certificate the issue previously allowed for a malicious (D)TLS server to bypass authentication once knowing which CA’s the client would accept.

items.title: NetScaler ADC/Gateway 请求走私
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者利用HTTP解析差异构造走私请求，可劫持会话或绕过访问控制。
items.repro_note: 向 ADC/Gateway 发送 CL/TE 冲突的走私请求观察后端解析差异
items.impact_scope: 边界负载均衡，前置代理链路
items.description: Inconsistent interpretation of HTTP requests ('HTTP Request/Response smuggling') vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. This issue affects ADC: before 14.1-73.37, before 13.1-64.23, before 14.1-73.37 FIPS, and before 13.1-37.279 and NDcPP; Gateway: before 14.1-73.37 FIPS and before 13.1-64.23.

items.title: NetScaler ADC/Gateway 缓冲区溢出DoS
items.summary_zh: 攻击者发送特制请求触发缓冲区溢出，导致ADC/Gateway异常或拒绝服务。
items.repro_note: 向 ADC/Gateway 请求路径发送超长或畸形请求触发溢出
items.impact_scope: 边界负载均衡/VPN 设备
items.description: Memory overflow vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. This issue affects ADC: before 14.1-73.37, before 13.1-64.23, before 14.1-73.37 FIPS, and before 13.1.37.279 FIPS and NDcPP; Gateway: before 14.1-73.37 and before 13.1-64.23 leading Memory overflow vulnerability leading to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of Service

items.title: NetScaler ADC/Gateway 内存溢出DoS
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用内存溢出缺陷使ADC/Gateway出现不可预知行为或服务不可用。
items.repro_note: 构造畸形请求触发 ADC/Gateway 内存溢出并观察服务异常
items.impact_scope: 边界负载均衡/VPN 设备
items.description: Memory overflow vulnerability vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. This issue affects ADC: before 14.1-73.37, before 13.1-64.23, before 14.1-73.37 FIPS, and before 13.1.37.279 FIPS and NDcPP; Gateway: before 14.1-73.37 and before 13.1-64.23 leading to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of Service

items.title: NetScaler ADC/Gateway 内存破坏DoS
items.summary_zh: 攻击者通过内存破坏缺陷导致ADC/Gateway运行异常或拒绝服务，影响业务可用性。
items.repro_note: 针对 ADC/Gateway 解析路径发送特制报文触发内存破坏
items.impact_scope: 边界负载均衡/VPN 设备
items.description: Memory overflow vulnerability vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. This issue affects ADC: before 14.1-73.37, before 13.1-64.23, before 14.1-73.37 FIPS, and before 13.1.37.279 FIPS and NDcPP; Gateway: before 14.1-73.37 and before 13.1-64.23 leading to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of Service

items.title: Canonical LXD 文件链接绕过
items.description: Improper link resolution in the migration receive path in Canonical LXD versions 4.0 and later (fixed in 4.0.14, 5.0.10, 5.21.8 and 6.10) on Linux allows an authenticated client that can create instances or custom storage volumes in a project, or a malicious migration source server, to write attacker-controlled files to arbitrary paths on the target host as root, leading to full host compromise.

items.title: Admin 未授权 缺失认证
items.description: Obot is an open-source AI agent/MCP platform. When authentication is disabled, every request is mapped to a synthetic "nobody" user that holds the Owner and Admin roles, so any unauthenticated party who can reach the exposed port obtains full administrative access to the Obot API and UI, including the ability to register and launch attacker-controlled MCP servers.

items.title: Nezha 未授权 开放重定向
items.description: Nezha 2.2.3 contains a Host header injection regression in the OAuth2 redirect endpoint. An attacker who induces a victim to begin OAuth2 login via a request that reaches Nezha with a forged Host header can cause an attacker-controlled callback URL to be used as the redirect_uri; if the OAuth2 provider accepts it, the victim's authorization code is delivered to the attacker origin, allowing the attacker to complete the OAuth2 login/binding flow and take over the account.

items.title: Use 未授权 CWE-1392
items.description: Use of default credentials vulnerability in Innotim Software, Telecommunications and Consultancy Trade Ltd. Co. Logsign SIEM allows Try Common or Default Usernames and Passwords. This issue affects Logsign SIEM: from 6.4.101 before 6.4.117.

items.title: Froxlor 文件链接绕过
items.description: Froxlor through 2.3.10 is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion via symlink following in the FTP data deletion cron task. Cron task 8 (deleteFtpData), queued when an FTP account is deleted, calls FileDir::makeCorrectDir() without the $fixed_homedir argument, so the symlink component walk is skipped, and then executes 'rm -rf' as root on the resulting path with string-level guards only.

items.title: OAuth 越权(IDOR)
items.description: obot versions before v0.21.1 fail to enforce Access Control Rules on the /mcp-connect endpoint, allowing any authenticated user to connect to restricted MCP servers if they possess the server ID. Attackers can bypass authorization checks to access and manipulate sensitive backend systems through MCP tool calls using stored OAuth credentials.

items.title: Canonical LXD 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: Path traversal in the btrfs storage driver in Canonical LXD versions 4.0.2 and later (fixed in 4.0.14, 5.0.10, 5.21.8 and 6.10) on Linux allows an authenticated client with permission to create instances in a project to delete arbitrary files on the host as root. The client does this with a crafted subvolume path containing ../ sequences, sent in either of two ways: in the optimized_header.yaml of an optimized btrfs backup, or in the btrfs migration header sent by a malicious migration source.

items.title: Rancher UI 未授权 XSS
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: An unauthenticated update of public UI settings could be used by remote attackers to execute a stored cross-site scripting attack in the Rancher UI, in SUSE Rancher 2.15 before 2.15.2, 2.14 before 2.14.6, 2.13 before 2.13.10, 2.12 before 2.12.14 and 2.11 before 2.11.18.

items.title: 内存破坏
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in FAST FAC1203R 20200116_2.0.4. The affected element is the function _tWlanTask of the component MmtAtePrase Parser. Performing a manipulation results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attacker must have access to the local network to execute the attack. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: An attacker can supply a crafted archive containing chained symlink entries so that a later entry resolves outside the output directory. This allows files outside output to be read or written, and overwriting startup scripts or configuration can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Bluehood 未授权 缺失认证
items.description: Bluehood monitors local bluetooth activity. A network attacker reachable on the dashboard port could read Bluetooth tracking data and modify application state — including the heartbeat URL, prune retention, device groups, and per-device notes — without a session cookie.

items.title: PyJWT 未授权 签名校验错误
items.description: PyJWT is a Python implementation of JSON Web Token standards. Consequently, an attacker who knows the public key can forge authenticated HMAC tokens.

items.title: 未授权 授权错误
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: vm2 before 3.12.2 contains an authorization bypass in the NodeVM external-module resolver. `.../node_modules/foo2/index.js`); the sibling passes `isPathAllowedForModule` and is loaded through `hostRequire`, so its top-level code runs in the host process before the exports are wrapped with `vm.readonly`, resulting in a sandbox escape and arbitrary code execution in the host context.

items.title: OAuth 未授权 授权错误
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Incorrect Authorization in the OAuth 1.0a authorization endpoint of Apache Roller 6.1.5 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker who learns an outstanding request token for a configured site-wide consumer to bind that token to an arbitrary user account, including an administrator, by submitting an unsigned authorization request. Only installations that configure an OAuth 1.0a site-wide consumer are affected, and exploitation requires knowledge of one of its outstanding request tokens.

items.title: Seetong设备认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可利用认证缺陷绕过校验，未授权访问或控制设备
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复固件；限制设备管理面访问
items.repro_note: 入口为设备认证/登录接口，需管理面可达；构造缺陷请求绕过校验
items.impact_scope: 视频监控设备，可能暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in Seetong T8108, T8108P, T8116 and T8232 4.6.1.4-build202604241011. The affected element is an unknown function of the component Debug Service. Such manipulation leads to improper authentication. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Kyverno路径遍历致集群提权
items.summary_zh: 具备相关权限攻击者可经%编码路径遍历创建集群Webhook，提升为集群管理员
cwe_labels: 意图代理错误(混源下载)
items.action_zh: 升级Kyverno修复版本；限制策略资源创建权限
items.repro_note: 入口Kyverno策略/异常创建，构造%编码目录遍历；需相关资源权限
items.impact_scope: K8s准入控制组件，集群高价值
items.description: kyverno before 1.19.1 fails to properly validate URL-encoded path segments in Policy apiCall urlPath, allowing namespace tenants to bypass the per-namespace clamp and create objects in other namespaces as the admission-controller ServiceAccount. Attackers can exploit this by using percent-encoded directory traversal sequences to create MutatingWebhookConfiguration objects cluster-wide or PolicyException objects in the kyverno namespace, enabling privilege escalation to cluster admin.

items.title: Froxlor文件链接绕过
items.summary_zh: 已认证面板用户可利用文件链接绕过操作受限文件，可能泄露或篡改数据
items.action_zh: 升级到官方修复版本；限制面板用户文件操作
items.repro_note: 入口面板文件/链接功能，构造链接绕过校验；需面板账户权限
items.impact_scope: 服务器管理面板，高价值内网资产
items.description: Froxlor is a server administration panel. Exploitation is deterministic and requires no race.

items.title: D-Link路由器L2TP越界写
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可通过L2TP控制通道发送畸形数据触发越界写，导致崩溃或代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级固件；无法升级时禁用L2TP或限制访问
items.repro_note: 入口L2TP控制通道解析tunnel_set_params；需服务可达
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in D-Link DIR-895L A1_102b07. Impacted is the function tunnel_set_params of the file tunnel.c of the component L2TP Control Channel Parser. Performing a manipulation results in out-of-bounds write. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

items.title: TOTOLINK N150RT命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵wlanif参数在Web管理接口注入OS命令，可能导致设备被控
items.action_zh: 升级固件；无法升级时限制Web管理面访问
items.repro_note: 入口formWlSiteSurvey，wlanif参数未过滤；Web需可达
items.impact_scope: SOHO路由器，管理面可能暴露
items.description: A weakness has been identified in TOTOLINK N150RT 3.4.0-B20201030. The affected element is the function system of the file /boafrm/formWlSiteSurvey of the component Web Management Interface. This manipulation of the argument wlanif causes os command injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: 未明确组件URL参数命令注入
items.title_zh: 未明确组件URL参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过操纵url参数触发OS命令注入，可能导致服务器命令执行
items.action_zh: 核查受影响组件并升级；限制接口访问
items.repro_note: 入口为接收url参数的接口；参数未过滤导致命令拼接
items.impact_scope: 组件未明确，需人工确认暴露面
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Netcore NBR200V2 1.3.241127.071246. Affected is the function system of the file /usr/bin/network_tools of the component Tools Ping Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument url results in os command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Apache Roller越权访问博客内容
items.title_zh: Apache Roller越权访问博客内容
items.summary_zh: 已认证用户可越权读取、修改或删除其他博客内容，导致数据泄露或篡改
items.action_zh: 升级到修复版本；无法升级时限制XML-RPC接口
items.repro_note: 入口XML-RPC博客API；需低权限账户，越权操作他博文
items.impact_scope: 博客系统，多用户内容平台
items.description: Missing Authorization in Apache Roller 6.1.5 allows an authenticated user to read, modify, or delete weblog content belonging to other weblogs through the legacy XML-RPC Blogger and MetaWeblog APIs, because the handlers authenticate the caller but do not verify the caller's permission on the weblog or entry actually affected. Only installations that enable the non-default global XML-RPC setting are affected; the per-weblog API flag defaults to enabled for UI-created weblogs.

items.title: FAST FAC1200R栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可向devdiscover服务发送畸形广告帧触发栈溢出，导致崩溃或代码执行
items.action_zh: 厂商未回应，暂无官方修复；限制devdiscover访问
items.repro_note: 入口devdiscover的广告帧解析；需服务可达
items.impact_scope: SOHO路由器，网络服务暴露面
items.description: A vulnerability was found in FAST FAC1200R 5.0_20201119_1.0.2. Affected is the function parse_advertisement_frame of the component devdiscover Service. The manipulation results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: FAST FAC1200R栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可发送畸形数据触发栈溢出，导致崩溃或代码执行
items.action_zh: 关注厂商修复；无法升级时限制网络服务访问
items.repro_note: 入口未明确，需结合固件审计网络服务与参数
items.impact_scope: SOHO路由器，网络服务暴露面
items.description: A vulnerability was determined in FAST FAC1200R 5.0_20201119_1.0.2. Affected by this vulnerability is the function MmtAtePrase of the component MmtAtePrase Parser. This manipulation causes stack-based buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Canonical LXD路径遍历提权
items.summary_zh: 具备实例创建权限的认证用户可通过btrfs备份导入路径遍历，以root删改宿主文件
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级LXD修复版本；限制实例创建权限
items.repro_note: btrfs备份导入subvolumes[].path遍历；需实例创建权限
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚拟化管理，宿主机高风险
items.description: Path traversal in the Btrfs storage driver (unpackVolume) in Canonical LXD on Linux allows an authenticated user with instance creation privileges to delete or replace arbitrary files and directories on the host filesystem as root via a crafted subvolumes[].path entry in backup/optimized_header.yaml during a btrfs optimized backup import.

items.title: Google Cloud Application Integration 授权错误
items.description: An Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in the task configuration in Google Cloud Application Integration versions prior to 2026-06-17 on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated Google Cloud user to execute arbitrary internal RPCs from inside Google's production network under a privileged identity using an internal-only task type. This vulnerability was patched on 17 June 2026, and no customer action is needed.

items.title: Untrusted Data 反序列化(RCE)
items.description: A Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in the JavaScript Task in Google Cloud Application Integration versions prior to 2026-06-28 on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated user with standard permissions to run arbitrary code on the shared production servers using a specially crafted script bypassing param guards. This vulnerability was patched on 28 June 2026, and no customer action is needed.

items.title: Dayforce Payroll 未授权 SQL注入
items.description: Dayforce Payroll is vulnerable to Time Based-Blind SQL Injection in password recovery functionality. The unauthenticated attacker can prepare GET request with one of the parameters filled in with an arbitrary SQL query. The parameter is interpreted as part of SQL predicate resulting in Time-Based Blind SQL Injection. Because vendor contact attempts were unsuccessful, the vulnerability has only been confirmed in version R2026.2.0 but may also affect other versions.

items.title: 未授权 访问控制缺失
items.description: An improper access control vulnerability in an internal API service on WatchGuard Access Points allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the AP to obtain a valid API session.

items.title: WatchGuard AP 未授权 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: An OS command injection vulnerability in the WatchGuard AP internal API service allows an attacker with network access to the AP to execute arbitrary shell commands on the underlying operating system.

items.title: Dayforce Payroll 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: Dayforce Payroll is vulnerable to Path Traversal in file download functionality. An unauthenticated attacker can sent GET request with file path parameter set to any path including an absolute local file path. Because vendor contact attempts were unsuccessful, the vulnerability has only been confirmed in version R2026.2.0 but may also affect other versions.

items.title: Froxlor 参数拼接注入
items.description: Froxlor before 2.3.12 does not restrict or escape the system.letsencryptchallengepath setting: unlike sibling settings hardened in GHSA-33mp, the field has no string_regexp or required_otp guard, and its value is concatenated unescaped into the acme.sh command line built in lib/Froxlor/Cron/Http/LetsEncrypt/AcmeSh.php and executed by the root cron via FileDir::safe_exec.

items.title: BaoTa 注入
items.description: A vulnerability was found in aaPanel BaoTa up to 11.8.0. Impacted is the function merge_split_file of the file /www/server/panel/class/files.py of the component File Merge Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument split_file_path results in command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Web Administration Service. The 内存破坏
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DI-8400 16.07. This vulnerability affects the function menu_nat_more_asp of the file menu_nat_more.asp of the component Web Administration Service. The manipulation of the argument opt results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: 注入
items.description: A weakness has been identified in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This vulnerability affects the function pop_usb_device of the file usr/lib/lua/luci/controller/api/zrUsb.lua of the component USB Device Management API. This manipulation of the argument path causes command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.description: A vulnerability was detected in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /api/ZRnetwork/firstLogin. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.description: A flaw has been found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This affects an unknown part of the file /api/ZRnetwork/firstSetup_wifi.
